title: What The Violin Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy absurdist
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The violin is the most human-sounding instrument there is
If you've heard it in a minor key you know the sound is his
Or hers — and what it sounds like is a voice that lost the words
And kept the feeling and the pitch and swapped the words for chords

[Pre-Chorus]
I cried once at a violin in a waiting room on television
Which was unexpected and efficient — I'll give it that precision

[Chorus]
What does the violin know that I don't know?
It knows the sound of grief before the grief knows where to go
What does the violin know in the wrong key?
It knows that sadness played with perfect technique sets you free
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The bow moves perpendicular and the string vibrates at four hundred
And forty cycles per second — and the whole room has wondered
What exactly in that physics translates to the soul
The violin knows and it's not telling — that's the role

[Bridge]
It can be a fiddle at a wedding or a requiem at dark
The same instrument, same strings, same bow, entirely different mark
The violin is not the music — it's the thing the music came through
And whatever you bring to it is what it brings to you

[Outro]
Violin knows… the sound is the feeling… violin knows
That's my boy
